classification.difficultyReason: Read ordinates, find two intersections with a horizontal level, and identify intersections of two trigonometric curves.

content.prompt: Here are the graphs of $y=\sin\theta$ and $y=\cos\theta$ drawn on the same axes.

spec.description: Both trigonometric curves on one grid above the response groups. Fine grid steps are 10 degrees and 0.1; heavier source grid lines occur at approximately 40 degrees and 0.5. Direct curve labels, arrowed axes, and all printed numeric labels are retained. Width is increased for readable graph interpolation and twelve horizontal tick labels.
spec.mathematics: Sine and cosine on 0 to 360 degrees, with vertical range -1 to 1.
spec.answerVisibility: Supplied graph only; no answer guides, intersection markers or response values are added.

children.label: a
children.prompt: From the graphs, read off the approximate value of:

answer.worked: At $\theta=60^{\circ}$, read the height of the cosine curve: $\cos60^{\circ}\approx0.5$.
At $\theta=210^{\circ}$, the sine curve has height $-0.5$, so $\sin210^{\circ}\approx-0.5$.
Read halfway between $70^{\circ}$ and $80^{\circ}$ on the sine curve. The height is just below $1$: $\sin75^{\circ}\approx0.97$.
At $\theta=20^{\circ}$, the cosine curve is between $0.9$ and $1$: $\cos20^{\circ}\approx0.95$.
At $\theta=150^{\circ}$, the cosine curve is between $-0.8$ and $-0.9$: $\cos150^{\circ}\approx-0.85$.
Read halfway between $20^{\circ}$ and $30^{\circ}$ on the sine curve: $\sin25^{\circ}\approx0.40$.
Read halfway between $230^{\circ}$ and $240^{\circ}$ on the sine curve: $\sin235^{\circ}\approx-0.8$.
Read halfway between $300^{\circ}$ and $310^{\circ}$ on the cosine curve: $\cos305^{\circ}\approx0.55$.

children.label: b
children.prompt: Find, from the graphs, two approximate values of $\theta$ between $0^{\circ}$ and $360^{\circ}$ for which:

answer.worked: The horizontal level $y=0.5$ meets the sine curve twice. Read the corresponding angles: $\theta\approx30^{\circ},150^{\circ}$.
The horizontal level $y=-0.5$ meets the cosine curve twice. Read the corresponding angles: $\theta\approx120^{\circ},240^{\circ}$.
The horizontal level $y=0.9$ meets the sine curve on either side of $90^{\circ}$. Read the angles: $\theta\approx65^{\circ},115^{\circ}$.
The horizontal level $y=0.6$ meets the cosine curve in the first and fourth quadrants. Read the angles: $\theta\approx55^{\circ},305^{\circ}$.
The horizontal level $y=0.8$ meets the sine curve on either side of $90^{\circ}$. Read the angles: $\theta\approx55^{\circ},125^{\circ}$.
The horizontal level $y=-0.8$ meets the cosine curve on either side of $180^{\circ}$. Read the angles: $\theta\approx145^{\circ},215^{\circ}$.
The horizontal level $y=-0.4$ meets the sine curve in the third and fourth quadrants. Read the angles: $\theta\approx205^{\circ},335^{\circ}$.
The horizontal level $y=-0.3$ meets the cosine curve in the second and third quadrants. Read the angles: $\theta\approx105^{\circ},255^{\circ}$.

children.label: c
children.prompt: Read from the graph the two values of $\theta$, between $0^{\circ}$ and $360^{\circ}$, for which $\sin\theta=\cos\theta$.

answer.worked: The sine and cosine curves have equal heights at their two intersections. Reading their horizontal coordinates gives $\theta=45^{\circ}$ and $225^{\circ}$.
